arxiv-2002-01929.title: Fermion masses and flavor mixing in modular A 4 A_{4} Symmetry
arxiv-2002-01929.creator: Mohammed Abbas Physics Department, Faculty of Science and Arts-Tabarjal, Jouf University Al-Jouf, KSA. Physics Department, Faculty of Sciences, Ain Shams University, Abbassiyah 11566, Cairo, Egypt.
arxiv-2002-01929.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Mohammed Abbas Physics Department, Faculty of Science and Arts-Tabarjal, Jouf University Al-Jouf, KSA. Physics Department, Faculty of Sciences, Ain Shams University, Abbassiyah 11566, Cairo, Egypt.. We consider a flavor model based on A_{4} modular group to account for both lepton and quark parameters (masses and mixing). The inverse seesaw mechanism is considered to produce the light neutrino masses.

arxiv-2012-09852.title: SpAtten: Efficient Sp arse Atten tion Architecture with Cascade Token and Head Pruning
arxiv-2012-09852.creator: Hanrui Wang, Zhekai Zhang, Song Han
arxiv-2012-09852.description: Abstract The attention mechanism is becoming increasingly popular in Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications, showing superior performance than convolutional and recurrent architectures. However, attention becomes the computation bottleneck because of its quadratic computational complexity to input length, complicated data movement and low arithmetic intensity.

arxiv-2204-06292.title: Reuse your features: unifying retrieval and feature-metric alignment
arxiv-2204-06292.creator: Javier Morlana, J.M.M. Montiel
arxiv-2204-06292.description: Abstract We propose a compact pipeline to unify all the steps of Visual Localization: image retrieval, candidate re-ranking and initial pose estimation, and camera pose refinement. Our key assumption is that the deep features used for these individual tasks share common characteristics, so we should reuse them in all the procedures of the pipeline.

arxiv-2204-12785.title: Plug-and-Play Adaptation for Continuously-updated QA
arxiv-2204-12785.creator: Kyungjae Lee, Wookje Han, Seung-won Hwang, Hwaran Lee Joonsuk Park Sang-Woo Lee
arxiv-2204-12785.description: Abstract Language models (LMs) have shown great potential as implicit knowledge bases (KBs). And for their practical use, knowledge in LMs need to be updated periodically. However, existing tasks to assess LMs’ efficacy as KBs do not adequately consider multiple large-scale updates.

arxiv-2208-04632.title: Branching Pomsets for Choreographies
arxiv-2208-04632.creator: Luc Edixhoven Sung-Shik Jongmans, José Proença, Guillermina Cledou
arxiv-2208-04632.description: Abstract Choreographic languages describe possible sequences of interactions among a set of agents. Typical models are based on languages or automata over sending and receiving actions. Pomsets provide a more compact alternative by using a partial order over these actions and by not making explicit the possible interleaving of concurrent actions. However, pomsets offer no compact representation of choices.

arxiv-2210-06549.title: GENERAL MANIPULABILITY THEOREM FOR A MATCHING MODEL
arxiv-2210-06549.creator: Paola B. Manasero and Jorge Oviedo
arxiv-2210-06549.description: Abstract abstract: In a many-to-many matching model in which agents’ preferences satisfy substitutability and the law of aggregate demand, we proof the General Manipulability Theorem. We result generalizes the presented in Sotomayor (1996 and 2012) for the many-to-one model. In addition, we show General Manipulability Theorem fail when agents’ preferences satisfy only substitutability.

arxiv-2403-02943.title: Transcription factor clusters as information transfer agents
arxiv-2403-02943.creator: Rahul Munshi, Jia Ling, Sergey Ryabichko, Eric Wieschaus, Thomas Gregor
arxiv-2403-02943.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rahul Munshi, Jia Ling, Sergey Ryabichko, Eric Wieschaus, Thomas Gregor. Deciphering how genes interpret information from transcription factor (TFs) concentrations within the cell nucleus remains a fundamental question in gene regulation. Recent advancements have revealed the heterogeneous distribution of TF molecules, posing challenges to precisely decoding concentration signals. Using high-resolution single-cell imaging of the fluorescently tagged TF Bicoid in living Drosophila embryos, we show that Bicoid accumulation in submicron clusters preserves the spatial information of the maternal Bicoid gradient.

arxiv-2404-12923.title: Probabilistic Numeric SMC Sampling for Bayesian Nonlinear System Identification in Continuous Time Journal: Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing
arxiv-2404-12923.creator: Joe D. Longbottom, Max D. Champneys, Timothy J. Rogers
arxiv-2404-12923.description: Abstract In engineering, accurately modeling nonlinear dynamic systems from data contaminated by noise is both essential and complex. Established Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods, used for the Bayesian identification of these systems, facilitate the quantification of uncertainty in the parameter identification process.

arxiv-2408-01039.title: Solving Caldeira-Leggett Model by Inchworm Method with Frozen Gaussian Approximation
arxiv-2408-01039.creator: Geshuo Wang, Siyao Yang, Zhenning Cai
arxiv-2408-01039.description: Abstract We propose an algorithm that combines the inchworm method and the frozen Gaussian approximation to simulate the Caldeira-Leggett model in which a quantum particle is coupled with thermal harmonic baths. In particular, we are interested in the real-time dynamics of the reduced density operator.

arxiv-2412-10326.title: k k -loose elements and k k -paving matroids
arxiv-2412-10326.creator: Jagdeep Singh
arxiv-2412-10326.description: Abstract . For a matroid of rank r r and a non-negative integer k k , an element is called k k -loose if every circuit containing it has size greater than r − k r-k . Zaslavsky and the author characterized all binary matroids with a 1 1 -loose element.

arxiv-2504-15202.title: Extending the ElGamal Cryptosystem to the Third Group of Units of ℤ n \mathbb{Z}_{n}
arxiv-2504-15202.creator: Jana Hamza, Mohammad EL Hindi, Seifeddine Kadri, Therrar Kadri, Yahya Awad
arxiv-2504-15202.description: Abstract In this paper, we extend the ElGamal cryptosystem to the third group of units of the ring ℤ n \mathbb{Z}_{n} , which we prove to be more secure than the previous extensions. We describe the arithmetic needed in the new setting. We also provide some numerical simulations that shows the security and efficiency of our proposed cryptosystem.

arxiv-2504-20853.title: Multiwavelength thermometry without a priori emissivity information: from promise to disillusionment
arxiv-2504-20853.creator: Jean-Claude Krapez
arxiv-2504-20853.description: Abstract Infrared (IR) thermography provides 2D radiance maps of the IR radiation leaving the surfaces of a scene, based on preliminary calibration. Then, to convert radiance maps into temperature maps, we need to know the emissivity of each element of the scene conjugated to each of the detector elements in the camera’s focal plane.

arxiv-2508-12140.title: Exploring Efficiency Frontiers of Thinking Budget in Medical Reasoning: Scaling Laws between Computational Resources and Reasoning Quality
arxiv-2508-12140.description: Abstract This study presents the first comprehensive evaluation of thinking budget mechanisms in medical reasoning tasks, revealing fundamental scaling laws between computational resources and reasoning quality. We systematically evaluated two major model families, Qwen3 (1.7B to 235B parameters) and DeepSeek-R1 (1.5B to 70B parameters), across 15 medical datasets spanning diverse specialties and difficulty levels.

arxiv-2601-00303.title: DepFlow: Disentangled Speech Generation to Mitigate Semantic Bias in Depression Detection
arxiv-2601-00303.creator: Yuxin Li, Xiangyu Zhang, Yifei Li, Zhiwei Guo, Haoyang Zhang, Eng Siong Chng, Cuntai Guan
arxiv-2601-00303.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yuxin Li, Xiangyu Zhang, Yifei Li, Zhiwei Guo, Haoyang Zhang, Eng Siong Chng, Cuntai Guan. Speech is a scalable and non-invasive biomarker for early mental health screening. However, widely used depression datasets like DAIC-WOZ exhibit strong coupling between linguistic sentiment and diagnostic labels, encouraging models to learn semantic shortcuts. As a result, model robustness may be compromised in real-world scenarios, such as Camouflaged Depression, where individuals maintain socially positive or neutral language despite underlying depressive states.

arxiv-2601-08901.title: Navigating Ideation Space: Decomposed Conceptual Representations for Positioning Scientific Ideas
arxiv-2601-08901.creator: Yuexi Shen, Minqian Liu, Dawei Zhou, Lifu Huang
arxiv-2601-08901.description: Abstract Scientific discovery is a cumulative process and requires new ideas to be situated within an ever-expanding landscape of existing knowledge. An emerging and critical challenge is how to identify conceptually relevant prior work from rapidly growing literature, and assess how a new idea differentiates from existing research.

plos-pone-0011225.title: A Randomised Trial to Compare the Safety, Tolerability and Efficacy of Three Drug Combinations for Intermittent Preventive Treatment in Children
plos-pone-0011225.creator: Kalifa Bojang, Francis Akor, Ousman Bittaye et al.
plos-pone-0011225.description: PLOS ONE research article. Results from trials of intermittent preventive treatment (IPT) in infants and children have shown that IPT provides significant protection against clinical malaria. Sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine (SP) given alone or in combination with other drugs has been used for most IPT programmes

pmc-11334592.title: Spatial transcriptomics profiling of gallbladder adenocarcinoma: a detailed two-case study of progression from precursor lesions to cancer
pmc-11334592.creator: Sophie Pirenne, Fátima Manzano-Núñez, Axelle Loriot, Sabine Cordi, Lieven Desmet, Selda Aydin, Catherine Hubert, Sébastien Toffoli, Nisha Limaye, Christine Sempoux, Mina Komuta, Laurent Gatto, Frédéric P Lemaigre
pmc-11334592.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundMost studies on tumour progression from precursor lesion toward gallbladder adenocarcinoma investigate lesions sampled from distinct patients, providing an overarching view of pathogenic cascades. Whether this reflects the tumourigenic process in individual patients remains insufficiently explored. Genomic and epigenomic studies suggest that a subset of gallbladder cancers originate from biliary intraepithelial neoplasia (BilIN) precursor lesions, whereas others form independently from BilINs. Spatial transcriptomic data supporting these conclusions are missing.

pmc-12080720.title: Alterações Hematológicas durante um Período de Sete Dias de Internação em Pacientes com Infarto Agudo do Miocárdio
pmc-12080720.creator: Cyntia Maria de Holanda Martins, José Gildo de Moura Monteiro, Dilênia de Oliveira Cipriano Torres, Dario Celestino Sobral, Maria Clara Santos Morais, Ulisses Ramos Montarroyos, Izadora Karina da Silva, Ana Célia Oliveira dos Santos, Cyntia Maria de Holanda Martins, José Gildo de Moura Monteiro, Dil
pmc-12080720.description: ResumoFundamento O infarto agudo do miocárdio é uma das principais causas de mortalidade em todo o mundo e a formação de placa aterosclerótica é o principal mecanismo fisiopatológico, que resulta em inflamação crônica e induz a maturação eritrocitária, podendo causar aumento no índice de amplitude de distribuição dos glóbulos vermelhos (RDW).

pmc-12496499.title: “An unusual cause of small bowel obstruction: Gallstone ileus, a rare presentation of chronic gallstone disease”
pmc-12496499.creator: Agrawal Srikant, Paudel Pratiksha, Khatiwada Bidur, Manandhar Kishor
pmc-12496499.description: Introduction and importanceGallstone ileus is a rare cause of mechanical small bowel obstruction, accounting for 1–4 % of cases and is most common in elderly females. It arises from the passage of a large gallstone through a cholecysto-enteric fistula into the intestinal lumen, where it lodges—typically in the terminal ileum—causing obstruction.

pmc-12663523.title: Release mechanisms of PLGA-based drug delivery systems: A review☆
pmc-12663523.creator: J. Siepmann, F. Siepmann
pmc-12663523.description: Poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA)-based microparticles and implants are of continuously increasing importance as parenteral controlled drug delivery systems. However, the underlying drug release mechanisms are often not understood, rendering product optimization difficult: The effects of formulation and processing parameters on drug release can be surprising. Also, upscaling and troubleshooting during production at industrial scale can be highly cumbersome.

pmc-13412959.title: Extending the Indications of Cochlear Implantation in Adults with Single-Sided Deafness. A Comprehensive Review
pmc-13412959.creator: Christos Tsilivigkos, Eleftherios Ferekidis, Marios Stavrakas
pmc-13412959.description: Introduction: Cochlear implantation is a well-established treatment for adults with bilateral postlingual deafness. In recent years, increasing research attention has focused on its use in patients with single-sided deafness (SSD) with or without tinnitus. Restoration of binaural auditory input through cochlear implantation may partially reestablish binaural processing.

pmc-13550118.title: Perioperative management for invasive brain–computer interface implantation under surgical navigation in a patient with traumatic spinal cord injury: a case report
pmc-13550118.creator: Shuhui Yang, Qiang Sun, Hong Mo, Wenyao Cui
pmc-13550118.description: BackgroundThe clinical application of invasive brain–computer interface combined with surgical navigation in patients with traumatic spinal cord injury remains limited, and there is a lack of a standardized perioperative nursing cooperation strategy. This paper summarized the intraoperative cooperation and nursing experience from a single case, aim to provide a reference for clinical practice.

uslaw-usc-t10-s7532.title: 10 U.S.C. § 7532 — Factories and arsenals: manufacture at
uslaw-usc-t10-s7532.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s7532.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part IV (Service, Supply, And Procurement); Chapter 763 (Procurement). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Army shall have supplies needed for the Department of the Army made in factories or arsenals owned by the United States, so far as those factories or arsenals can make those supplies on an economical basis.
